activities.name: First Notice of Loss
activities.description: Initial warranty claim submission from dealer or customer

activities.name: Verify Coverage
activities.description: Verification of warranty contract coverage and claim validity

activities.name: Damage Assessment
activities.description: Technical assessment of vehicle damage and required repairs

activities.name: Request Documentation
activities.description: Request and validate parts documentation and pricing from dealer

activities.name: Liability Determination
activities.description: Determine warranty liability and coverage for labor costs

activities.name: Claim Investigation
activities.description: Detailed investigation of complex or high-value warranty claims

activities.name: Assignment
activities.description: Assignment to fraud specialist for pattern analysis and risk scoring

activities.name: Approve Settlement
activities.description: Settlement approved for payment to dealer

activities.name: Resolution and Settlement
activities.description: Final resolution - denial with reason code or settlement offer

activities.name: Generate Payment Confirmation
activities.description: Generate payment confirmation and quality audit documentation

activities.name: Claim Closure
activities.description: Final closure of claim with all documentation complete
